title: Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment (MARCA) of Individual Case Safety Reports in Pharmacovigilance
abstract: arXiv:2610.33279v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Introduction: Increasing volumes of individual case safety reports (ICSRs) challenge expert-led causality assessment in pharmacovigilance. We developed MARCA (Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Causality Assessment), a four-agent framework for Naranjo-based assessment, and evaluated agreement with human experts and exploratory differences between non-RAG and RAG-labelled scores.   Methods: MARCA combined scientific literature retrieval, drug-label assessment, objective-evidence classification, and clinical causality reasoning using Gemini 2.5 Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2. translated_title: 药物警戒中个体病例安全报告的多智能体检索增强因果关系评估（MARCA）
translated_abstract: 引言：日益增多的个体病例安全报告（ICSR）对药物警戒领域中由专家主导的因果关系评估构成了挑战。我们开发了MARCA（多智能体检索增强因果关系评估），这是一个基于Naranjo量表进行评估的四智能体框架，并评估了其与人类专家评分的一致性，同时探索性比较了非RAG与RAG标注评分之间的差异。方法：MARCA结合了科学文献检索、药品说明书评估、客观证据分类和临床因果关系推理，采用Gemini 2.5 Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2模型。智能体生成的推理依据用于辅助人工评分。共识专家参考标准涵盖来自FAERS（2025年第一季度至第二季度）的215份ICSR和1,562个药物-事件组合（DEC）。一致性采用百分比一致性和Cohen's kappa系数进行衡量。结果：在问题层面，Naranjo Q2的一致性为96.8%（kappa = 0.491；95% CI 0.265-0.663），Q5的一致性为85.4%（kappa = 0.269；95%（摘要在此截断）
tldr: 该研究提出了MARCA四智能体框架，结合文献检索、说明书评估与临床推理，利用大语言模型对药物警戒报告进行Naranjo因果关系自动评估，与人类专家评分达到较高一致性。
en_tdlr: This study developed MARCA, a four-agent retrieval-augmented framework using LLMs for Naranjo-based causality assessment of individual case safety reports in pharmacovigilance, achieving high agreement with human expert scoring.
